package.name: safety_sector_tuner_3d
package.description: Per-sector wall-margin (safety_distance) tuner for the global raceline NLP. Clone of friction_sector_tuner: slicing GUI marks [start, end] sector ranges, dyn_safety_tuner.cfg auto-generates per- sector dynamic_reconfigure sliders, safety_sector_server.py mirrors the sliders to /safety_sector_params/Sector{i}/safety_distance rosparam + <map>/safety_sectors.yaml. gen_global_racing_line.py reads the rosparam tree at NLP setup to build a per-grid-step d_safe[idx] table.
